thread.title_full: Hoover school system hires new RC3 coordinator, 2 new assistant principals - NewsBreak

author: STAFF
title: Hoover school system hires new RC3 coordinator, 2 new assistant principals - NewsBreak
text:
By STAFF ,
15 hours ago The Hoover Board of Education on Tuesday night approved a new coordinator for the Riverchase Career Connection Center and two new assistant principals. Matthew Epps, who has been principal of the Shelby County Career Technical Education Center, will be the new coordinator at the Riverchase Career Connection Center. Mallory Creel, a math teacher at Berry Middle School, was named the new assistant principal at Greystone Elementary School. and Emily Fogleman, the lead enrichment specialist for Hoover City Schools, will be the new assistant principal at Brock’s Gap Intermediate School.
